verdicts.reason: The two are almost the same. Both put the quote over a mostly empty top band about 140px tall. In both, the left circle sits fully inside the canvas instead of bleeding off the edge as in the original, and it now crowds the headline. Both leave a dead lower-left area where only the small SOLSTICE logo floats, and the can sits closer to the centre of the maroon circle than in the original, losing the original's bleed-off-the-corner tension. A squeezes the attribution up close under the headline, about 38px versus about 50px in the original. B keeps the original's gap between headline and attribution, so it is very slightly more faithful.
